SuperAdmin.title: SuperAdmin
SuperAdmin.description: Represents the Super Admin of the ParkX platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Super Admin entity.

email.description: Email address of the Super Admin.

firstName.description: First name of the Super Admin.

lastName.description: Last name of the Super Admin.

Vendor.title: Vendor
Vendor.description: Represents a vendor (parking lot business) on the ParkX platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Vendor entity.

email.description: Contact email address for the vendor.

parkingSpotLimit.description: Maximum number of parking spots allowed for the vendor.

status.description: Status of the vendor (e.g., Pending, Active, Trial).

trialEnds.description: The date the vendor's trial period ends.

EndUser.title: EndUser
EndUser.description: Represents an end-user (customer) of a vendor.

id.description: Unique identifier for the End User entity.

cancellationRequested.description: Flag indicating if the user has requested to cancel their spot.

cancellationRequestDate.description: The date the user requested cancellation.

ParkingSpot.title: ParkingSpot
ParkingSpot.description: Represents a parking spot within a vendor's parking lot.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Parking Spot entity.

name.description: Name or identifier of the parking spot (e.g., 'A1', 'Spot 10').

isAvailable.description: Indicates whether the parking spot is currently available.

userId.description: The ID of the EndUser assigned to this spot.

Communication.title: Communication
Communication.description: Represents a communication thread or message between users.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Communication entity.

senderId.description: Identifier of the user who sent the message. Could be SuperAdmin, Vendor, or EndUser.

receiverId.description: Identifier of the user who received the message. Could be SuperAdmin, Vendor, or EndUser.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the message was sent.

VendorInvoice.title: VendorInvoice
VendorInvoice.description: Represents an invoice for a vendor, covering subscriptions and additional services.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Vendor Invoice.

vendorId.description: The ID of the vendor this invoice belongs to.

vendorName.description: The name of the vendor (denormalized for display).

amount.description: The total amount of the invoice.

dueDate.description: The date the invoice is due.

status.description: The current status of the invoice (e.g., Pending, Paid, Overdue).

notes.description: Additional notes or line items for the invoice.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore structure is designed to ensure Authorization Independence, role-based access control, and scalability for the ParkX application.  Authorization Independence is achieved by denormalizing authorization data, specifically `vendorId` in `endUsers` and `parkingSpots`, which prevents the need for `get()` calls in security rules. The structure is segregated based on roles and entity ownership to maintain a homogeneous security posture within collections. QAPs are supported through structural segregation and path-based ownership for private user data and membership maps where collaboration is needed.

Specifically, the structure is as follows:

*   `/superAdmins/{superAdminId}`: Stores Super Admin profiles. Only one super admin will be available in the system at any time. Collection enforces that only authenticated super admins can manage super admins profiles.
*   `/vendors/{vendorId}`: Stores Vendor profiles. Super Admin has create, read, update and delete access. Vendor can read and update own profile.
* `/vendorInvoices/{vendorInvoiceId}`: Stores invoices for vendors. Super Admin has full access.
*   `/vendors/{vendorId}/endUsers/{endUserId}`: Stores End Users, nested under their respective Vendor. Includes denormalized `vendorId` for authorization. Prevents unauthorized access by other vendors and enables simple ownership-based security rules. Vendor owns all endUsers under vendor document.
*   `/vendors/{vendorId}/parkingSpots/{parkingSpotId}`: Stores Parking Spots, nested under their respective Vendor. Includes denormalized `vendorId` for authorization. Prevents unauthorized access by other vendors and enables simple ownership-based security rules. Vendor owns all parkingSpots under vendor document.
*   `/communications/{communicationId}`: Stores communications between SuperAdmins, Vendors and EndUsers. Access control is managed via `senderId` and `receiverId`.
